data.standardized_narrative: At the 2015 year-end the syndicate recorded an adverse re-estimation of prior underwriting years: gross prior-year claims estimates increased by GBP 10.4m (15.5% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 67.049m). This deterioration was driven by adverse development in Political Risks and the Consumer Products portfolio, which more than offset favourable run-off in the Property book. The gross prior-year movement was calculated from the syndicate's gross claims development table (years 2011-2013).
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 48.0m (2014: GBP 48.3m) is an improvement of GBP 0.2m (2014: improvement of GBP 9.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the favourable Property run-off offset by unfavourable development for Political Risk and Consumer Products business.

The ultimate loss for the 2010 year of account has been driven primarily by poor performance in the Property account. Significant Catastrophe losses arising from earthquakes in Chile and New Zealand were incurred.

The ultimate loss for the 2011 year of account has primarily been driven by poor performance in the Property account arising from exposure to the Japanese earthquake, Thailand floods, Hurricane Irene, US tornadoes and Superstorm Sandy.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (columns 2011-2013) which produced a net gross deterioration of +GBP 10.4m. The narrative discloses a small net improvement of GBP 0.2m within net claims incurred (net of reinsurance) which was not used as the primary gross PYD source. Some LOB mappings (e.g. Political Risk -> Reinsurance - Specialty; Consumer Products -> Accident & Health) are approximate because the report uses non-standard class names; amounts by LOB for PYD are not separately quantified in the report. Reinsurance to close activity is described elsewhere in the report (closure of 2010/2011 into 2014) but the gross claims development table was used as the primary source; RITC distortions were considered and the triangle columns used exclude the most recent two years.
